gate.rule: CONTRACT pilot gate as amended by A1/A9: (1) < 2% of replays error; (2) projected full-run cost feasible (CPU-cluster allowed); (3) some policy differs from default@defaults beyond noise on validation (|mean_k r - 1| > 3 pooled sd on some val cell AND |mean segment delta| > 2 SE over >= 3 independent segments; paired CRN replicates k = 3..10, not used by any selection)

condition_2_cost.basis: projection.json: recommended plan (full train each evaluation, B = 400, M2 at equal budget B, plus test and robustness) = 16.8 M local-equivalent replay-s, 279 h on the workstation alone, 40 h wall on the 5 measured CPU cluster nodes + workstation (PROJECTION); every single lr-train run fits one CPU cluster node in 3.5 h (epyc9654p) / 5.5 h (epyc7702p)

condition_3_differs_beyond_noise.note: M1, M0 and all three default-arm heuristics differ from default@defaults beyond noise, positively, in every load mode (LR-09 stratification); round_robin differs negatively. Against the val-best default-arm heuristic (llm-d-precise-prefix) no tuned or heuristic policy differs beyond noise overall (the segment clause fails; M1 vs ramjet passes in the closed-loop mode only).

decisions: Train subset (12 of 34 train cells, 30% of the full train replay cost): stratified by family (Mooncake 6, sessions 3, AgentX 3), N (4 and 8 within each family), load mode and level (Mooncake open L1/L2/L2-islp1.5/L3 + closed L2/L3; sessions open L1/L3 + closed L2; AgentX lanes L1/L2/L3), Mooncake segments w0/w2/w4 twice each; written longest-first so AgentX replays do not set the generation barrier (cells/train_subset.jsonl, sha256 2d44a0a8...).

Objective clipped_log_ratio of goodput_rps_window vs default@defaults on the same replicate (LR-01 action 3, pre-registered in HEADLINE_TEST.json; calibration audit r1 F1 recommends it because round_robin-like candidates collapse session cells); K = 2 CRN replicates per evaluation from a pool of 8 (A1), popsize 16 (LR-03: larger lambda under noise), UH-CMA-ES re-evaluation of the top 2 per generation on fresh replicates (r_lambda = 2/16, LR-03 action 3), validation every 5 generations on all 14 val cells k = 0..2 (best-so-far sample and CMA mean), equal budget 480 evaluations (30 generations) per run.

Restarts: 2 seeds per rung (LR-10 asks >= 3 in phase 2; the pilot measures restart spread). Rung config selected by val k = 0..2 over both seeds' validated candidates (LR-10): M0 = m0-s1 generation 25 best-so-far (0.12893 vs m0-s2 0.12830), M1 = m1-s2 generation 30 CMA mean (0.16454 vs m1-s1 0.16411).

M0 space (spaces/m0_default_tuned.yaml): overlap_score_credit [0, 4], overlap_score_credit_decay [0, 4], prefill_load_scale log [0.05, 50], decode_active_request_weight log [0.5, 4096] (0.5 stands in for the default 0, below one block per request), router_temperature [0, 1] as a catalog parameter (equivalent to the router_config sidecar); init = defaults; sigma0 0.15 internal = about 18% decision flips vs the defaults on reconstructed candidate tables.

M1 space (spaces/m1_learned_v1.yaml): learned-choice feature_set v1, rank 0, tie_break one_draw; theta[0] pinned at -1 (scale anchor, start theta0 = -e0 = default argmin; LR-05); temperature FIXED at 0, not tuned (LR-05 action 2, LR-15 action 3: at tau = 0 the pinned theta0 fixes the scale, so tau would only add a flat/gauge direction; tau > 0 is a separate named variant); bounds theta_j in +-4 s_j with s_j = sd(f0)/sd(f_j) from approximate candidate tables (s = 25.6, 17.7, 5.33, 80.8, 110, 21.2, 3.22: the build-stage placeholder bounds [-8, 8] could not let kv_load_frac or active_requests_s matter); sigma0 0.004 internal = 0.032 s_j physical, about 20% decision flips vs theta0 (LR-05 action 4 target 10-30%, a hypothesis range).

Placement: per CONTRACT A9 (binding; CPU-cluster lane status ok) every lr-train job projected above ~1 h local ran on the CPU cluster, one job per node (2 x epyc9654p EPYC 9654P --mem 400G, 2 x epyc7702p EPYC 7702P --mem 160G; seed-2 runs hit their 2:15 time limit at generation 29 and were resumed on epyc9654p). Short batches (heuristic screen, validation, warm-up check, one full-train generation) ran locally through CR/slots.

Two strong heuristics at defaults chosen on TRAIN data only (no val peeking): a defaults-arm screen of all 9 catalog heuristics on the pilot train subset (k = 0, 1) ranked llm-d-precise-prefix (+0.169) and ramjet (+0.166) first by mean clipped log-ratio; lmetric (+0.165) is within 0.0006 of ramjet (a tie), so it was evaluated on val as well. Calibration evidence (RR collapses on sessions and AgentX) pointed the same way: cache/affinity-aware policies.
Validation evaluation on fresh replicates k = 3..10 (8 per cell; k = 0..2 were used for lr-train's selection), all 14 val cells, every policy paired with default@defaults on the same replicate.
LR-15 drift check (L1-only vs L3-only, N4 vs N8 M1 runs and cross-play) deferred to early stage 4 and costed in the projection; it needs no new plumbing.

Plateau: the first validation checkpoint (every 5 generations = 80 evals) at which the run's

replay-seconds per steady-state generation (>= 4, reference cached) divided by the median
measured generation wall (history.jsonl gen_wall_s) on that node type.

projection.reading: Equal budget B = 400 evaluations per run (M1 plateaus by 160-240, M0 by 80-400 on noisy val), 3 restarts per policy, full train each evaluation: 10 tuned baselines (30 runs) + M1 (3) + M2 ranks 2-4 (9) + ablations (queue threshold 6, simulator-only features 3) + LR-15 drift check + val selection + test (25 policies x 3 replicates x 60 cells) + robustness (lag 50/200 ms, speedup 0.8/1.2 on finalists, LR-14 variants). A2.1 requires the equal CMA-ES budget for every policy, learned or baseline, so the recommended plan runs M2 at B; the dimension-scaled M2 rule (B x n/7, a hypothesis) is a sensitivity bound. With M2 at equal budget B: 16.8 M replay-s, ~40 h wall on the 5 measured CPU cluster nodes + workstation, ~3.5 h per run on epyc9654p; with M2 budget scaled by dimension (n/7, hypothesis) 26.7 M replay-s and ~63 h, critical path a 19 h rank-4 run. Rotating 12-cell subsets per generation cut training cost ~3.4x (8.4 M / 5.4 M). Test and robustness together are ~0.2 M replay-s (<1.5%). Training dominates; the knobs are B, the M2 budget rule and rotating subsets.

recommendations_for_phase2: Equal budget B = 400 evaluations (25 generations x 16) per run, 3 restarts per policy (LR-10), full train each evaluation unless the wall-clock forces rotating subsets (--cells-per-gen 12; Spearman 0.95 subset vs full on 16 candidates).

Add cma maxstd (e.g. 0.3 internal units) to bounded spaces with possibly flat coordinates (M0 seed 1 sigma divergence); widen M0 prefill_load_scale to [0.05, 500] (tuned values 17-25 sit at 0.9 of the log range).
Keep M1 bounds from feature spreads; the selected theta uses overlap_frac 9.8-13.6 and active_requests_s -45 to -49, inside the +-100 / +-440 bounds.
Stage-4 audit should examine the M1 Mooncake concentration (worker share up to 0.51 at N8) for sim-artifact exploitation (LR-13) and check it under staleness (A5).

The headline bar is high: default-arm heuristics are already +0.133-0.135 clipped log-ratio over default@defaults on val, and pilot M1 beats the best of them by +0.030 (mean ratio 1.032) without a segment-level significant difference; tuned baselines may close the gap.
